skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Conduct independent research and apply research methodologies effectively.
Analyze and interpret data to address real-world issues in resource and environmental management.
Identify and solve problems in resource and environmental management.
Evaluate and critique research findings and management practices in resource and environmental fields.
Produce well-structured and logically coherent reports.
Work effectively in teams and independently.
Manage time efficiently to meet project deadlines.
Apply knowledge of environmental management principles and practices.
Understand and manage resources effectively in economic and environmental contexts.
Analyze economic issues related to resource and environmental management.
Evaluate and propose policies for resource and environmental management.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders in resource and environmental management.
Adapt to changes in organizational and environmental management contexts.

prerequisite_courses: Complete 75% of the program's credit requirements
